finalText:
**Build's clean, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid. New config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw. Now `undefined` maps to disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise from the deps, not errors. Build finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors, exit 0.
